title: Escape and timeout gate tests on the EVA-03 runner
goal: Gate tests 1–5 of the T01 contract on the EVA-03 runner, each proved to fail on an unconfined runner
acceptance: Filesystem escape (NERV state, keys, $HOME, writes outside the workspace, symlink and hardlink traversal), network egress (TCP, UDP, DNS, loopback port probe), credential denial (environment, Keychain), grader tampering (read hidden grader data, write grader outputs), timeout and cancellation (no surviving process, including one in its own session; explicit timed_out/cancelled event)
Each confinement test also runs against a fixture sandbox-exec that drops the profile and shows the breach there
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Join tests in CI on macOS; npm test
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.25 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio. Re-estimated 2026-11-19 from 0.75 h to 1.5 h and narrowed (owner decision): the recovery join test moved to F-049-T13; the orphan escape found while writing it is B-099.
